title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Fri 27 Nov
summary: A light day (forecast light). Thermals stayed light all day. The upslope ran from about 10:45 to about 17:35. A low day for November: the base stayed down near 4,300 ft (normal 4,500–5,500 ft). Yesterday evening, the page called it normal, about 4,300 ft, a miss. Midday the base averaged about 4,300 ft by the Kekoa camera, right on yesterday evening's number; the morning update said about 4,300 ft and was right on; at 10:00, from the 09:00 base, about 3,800 ft, off by 500 ft. Most of the day the shear line was crossing Kula Highway near Waiakoa. Data gaps: no readings all day from 3 stations (Kahikinui, Nakula, Upper Kahikinui); the Mesonet could not be reached on 48 of 52 updates.
